title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 81 (Register of charges kept by Registrar)

content.overview: The Registrar must maintain a register of charges for each company in the prescribed form and manner, recording particulars of charges registered under the chapter. The Registrar's register is open to inspection by any person on payment of prescribed fees. It is distinct from the company's own internal register under section 85.
content.glance: The Registrar must maintain a register of charges for each company in the prescribed form and manner, recording particulars of charges registered under the chapter. content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 81 (Register of charges kept by Registrar). The Registrar must maintain a register of charges for each company in the prescribed form and manner, containing particulars of charges registered under the chapter. The Registrar's register is open to inspection by any person on payment of prescribed fees. It is distinct from the company's own internal register of charges under section 85, and the underlying filing duty for a charge is governed by section 77 and related provisions. Legal verification remains open.

sections.heading: Registrar's register
sections.body: The Registrar maintains, for each company, a register containing particulars of charges registered under the chapter, in the prescribed form and manner.

sections.heading: Inspection
sections.body: The register of charges maintained by the Registrar is open to inspection by any person on payment of prescribed fees.

sections.heading: Distinction from company records
sections.body: Section 81 concerns the Registrar's register. Section 85 separately requires the company to maintain its own register and copies of charge instruments at the registered office; section 77 governs the company's charge-registration duty.

hypotheticals.question: A person wants to inspect the Registrar's register of charges for a company. What does section 81 provide?
hypotheticals.analysis: The Registrar's register is open to inspection by any person on payment of prescribed fees.

hypotheticals.question: Does the Registrar's register replace the company's internal register of charges?
hypotheticals.analysis: No. Section 81 concerns the Registrar's register of registered charges; section 85 separately requires the company to maintain its own register and copies of charge instruments.

distinctions.title: Registrar register and company register
distinctions.left: Section 81 requires the Registrar to maintain the register of registered charges, open to public inspection on prescribed fees.
distinctions.right: Section 85 requires the company to maintain its internal register and copies of charge instruments.

rows.right: Member/creditor without fee; other persons on prescribed fees

misconceptions.trap: Treating the Registrar's register under section 81 as the company's own register under section 85.
misconceptions.correction: Section 81 governs the Registrar's register; section 85 governs the company's internal register and instrument copies.

misconceptions.trap: Assuming inspection of the Registrar's register is always free.
misconceptions.correction: Section 81 allows inspection on payment of prescribed fees.

misconceptions.trap: Assuming section 81 itself replaces the company's charge-filing duty.
misconceptions.correction: The filing duty is governed by section 77 and related provisions.
